name: zmodel_matlbuffer_shutdown
description: zModel_MatlBuffer::Shutdown releases active materials, frees the material pool, resets material-pool globals, releases dynamic global-string entries, clears the reuse cache, and returns zero.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The native smoke reaches zModel_MatlBuffer::Shutdown through zModel_Display::ShutdownThunk/zModel_Display::Shutdown.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x480f10 calls zModel_MatlBuffer::ReleaseAllActive, frees g_zModel_MatlPool when non-null, clears the pool pointer, capacity, and in-use count, sets free and active head indices to -1, calls zRndr::GlobalStringTable_ReleaseDynamicEntries, clears g_zModel_MatlReuseCache, and returns zero.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x480f10 has no warnings or tags and shows the same material-pool shutdown sequence and zero return.
The dependency frontier for 0x480f10 has no visible source blockers; material release, global-string release, and free provider dependencies are accepted.
The native zmodel_display_shutdown_smoke reaches this function through display shutdown and verifies material-pool globals, free/active head indices, and reuse cache are reset.
